title: rwb-access answer behind the case and queue list: element names, the P2 attribution of the contract dependency, the authorise branch, the extract record, the login and the parameter and reference paths are not settled by any source read
source: Legacy RWB-E2-033 sections 3, 4, 7, 8, 12, 13 and 14; Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3 T3.1, T3.2, T6.1, T6.2 and T-A.2 (API-P4-012); Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3 A2.7 and A2.8 (AC-EXC-P4-004-05, AC-ALT-P4-007-02); Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 10, 13 and 41; _work/msr/context/P4.md service row and ownership rows; Template and Rules v1 R5.5, R7.2 and R9
section: s1 Story; s3 Preconditions; s7 Acceptance criteria; s8 Business rules BR5, BR6, BR7; s10 Authority; s11 Data; s12.1 REST operations provided; s12.2 REST operations consumed; s12.7 Tables owned; s13 Solution plan; s14 Validation and messages
description: One combined row for the unsettled points of the access slice of RWB-E2-033. (a) Element names: the sources name the session response type and the four scope values, and fix no element of the right, the scope predicate, the queue or region code, the versions or the field markers. (b) Attribution: the WP records the contract dependency RWB-P2-E2033-CON (the composed page of rwb-integration), while Architecture v5 slide 13 draws P3 to P4 by REST and no P2 to P4 call at all, so the contract this answer must satisfy is a build-against shape and not a run-time caller. (c) Authorise branch: the per-object check and its batch are the contract of RWB-P4-E1037-CON, whose path and request and answer shapes are not named in any source read. (d) Extract record: FSD P4 A2.7 fixes the decision code AC-EXPT, the actor, the filters and the row count, and rwb-access owns no access-log table in the 5 rows of the context pack, so the record is a decision-log row written by RWB-P4-E1039-APP and its field names and write path are that story's. (e) Login: no source names the rwb-access database login under DP-02. (f) Paths and values of the consumed contract: no source read names the parameters path, the reference-data path, the parameter row names of the page-size bound, or the text of MSG-GEN-006.
evidence: TSD P4 T-A.2 gives GET /me/session with Response 'Session' and no element list; FSD P4 A2.7 gives the codes AC-READ, AC-EXPT and AC-DENY only; context pack P4 lists 5 tables and 4 REST operations, none of them an access-log table or an authorise path; Architecture v5 slide 13 matrix shows P3 R to P4 and P2 R to P5 only
proposed: Fix the element list of the session answer, the authorise branch and its batch bound, and the extract record fields in the baseline review of RWB-P2-E2033-CON with the rwb-access contract owner, and record the P2 attribution as a stated build-against dependency of the access slice; the login and the message text follow the platform template and the platform message standard.
